product_lineage.devicex: SDX installed on specific hardware — branded appliance (Branch-in-a-Box, School-in-a-Box)
product_lineage.stackx: Management, orchestration, observability, automation, ITSM, compliance, and SOC platform layer above/around DeviceX/SDX

base: built from scratch — not copied from a prior proposal

devicex_sdx.description: Select one or more DeviceX/SDX capability modules. SD-WAN is the core; others are optional add-ons.

modules.name: SD-WAN
modules.notes: Core module — appears in every DeviceX proposal. Include unless the customer does not need SD-WAN.

modules.name: Firewall
modules.notes: Stateful packet inspection (base). 30-June adds NGFW + Suricata IDS/IPS + URL filtering + TLS inspection. Customer selects variant.

modules.name: NVR / Video Surveillance
modules.notes: Two sub-options: NVR Without AI (EGYCash model) vs NVR with Edge Analytics — AI object detection, facial recognition, LPR, behavioral analytics, ONVIF integration (30-June model). MOE covers CCTV via SD-WAN tunnels to central NVR, not edge NVR.

modules.name: IP-PBX / Unified Communications
modules.notes: SIP/IAX2, IVR, voicemail-to-email, call recording, conference, mobile app, CRM integration. Present in EGYCash and 30-June; absent from ECMI/CPC.

modules.name: SASE / Zero Trust Access
modules.notes: Device profiling, Zero Trust, on-prem edge, LAN/WAN conditional secure access, device health assessment, user authentication, internal asset protection. Present in 30-June only.

modules.name: Network Services (DNS/DHCP/LDAP/RADIUS)
modules.notes: On-demand branch services catalogue. Present in 30-June only.

modules.name: Virtualization / Container Platform
modules.notes: KVM VM hosting, Docker container deployment, Kubernetes orchestration, multi-tenant workload isolation, resource allocation/scaling, app lifecycle mgmt, load balancing/service discovery, persistent storage, network policy enforcement, monitoring/logging integration. Present in 30-June only.

modules.name: Business Workloads Hosting Platform
modules.notes: Secure, reliable, high-performance environment for mission-critical apps. Present in EGYCash, ECMI, CPC.

modules.name: DeviceX/SDX Operations (Centralized Edge Mgmt)
modules.notes: Device provisioning/lifecycle, SD-WAN tunnel mgmt, firewall policy mgmt, monitoring (device health, agent status, tunnel status), centralized config push. Present in MOE only.

stackx.group: StackX — control / orchestration / SOC / operations layer
stackx.description: Select one or more StackX modules. The 16 modules below are the full StackX coverage list from the MOE proposal.

modules.name: StackX Endpoint Management & Analytics
modules.notes: Hardware/software inventory, OS/version tracking, service/startup mgmt, remote control, software deploy/uninstall, registry mgmt, print mgmt, UBA, remote desktop. Includes StackX Print Management sub-module.

modules.name: StackX Automation & Orchestration
modules.notes: CLI/API/REST automation, no-code workflow builder, RBAC, multi-vendor orchestration, centralized console, action logging, custom actions UI builder, workflow templates across infra/apps/services.

modules.name: StackX Observability & APM
modules.notes: Metrics/logs/traces, ML anomaly detection, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry support, service dependency mapping, unified dashboards, proactive alerting, RBAC, encrypted comms, audit logging, horizontal scaling, hybrid on-prem/cloud.

modules.name: StackX TrueView
modules.notes: To be authored from MOE Appendix 5.1.4.

modules.name: StackX Identity Management (IDM)
modules.notes: To be authored from MOE Appendix 5.1.5. Covers IAM, MFA, RBAC, identity lifecycle.

modules.name: StackX Backup
modules.notes: To be authored from MOE Appendix 5.1.6. Covers backup/recovery strategy, data protection, ransomware resilience.

modules.name: StackX Operations Monitoring & Configuration Management Enterprise Management
modules.notes: To be authored from MOE Appendix 5.1.7.

modules.name: StackX Network Operations Enterprise Management
modules.notes: To be authored from MOE Appendix 5.1.8.

modules.name: StackX ITSM Platform Enterprise Management
modules.notes: Incident/problem/change mgmt, ITSM workflows, CAB integration, service catalog, MTTR analytics. Integrated with StackX console.

modules.name: StackX Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) Enterprise Management
modules.notes: To be authored from MOE Appendix 5.1.10.

modules.name: StackX Compliance Assurance System
modules.notes: To be authored from MOE Appendix 5.1.11. CIS, PCI-DSS compliance reporting, regulatory alignment.

modules.name: StackX Operations Integrity Platform
modules.notes: Systems Operations Integrity, DeviceX SASE & ZTNA Framework, Integrated Security Controls & Case Management. From MOE Appendix 5.1.11.1–5.1.11.3.

modules.name: StackX Call Center Management
modules.notes: To be authored from MOE Appendix 5.1.12.

modules.name: StackX Event & Log Management (SIEM)
modules.notes: Log ingestion/parsing/enrichment, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, data retention tiers (hot/warm/cold/frozen), distributed search, correlation rules, ML jobs.

modules.name: StackX SOC Operations (SIEM/SOAR/EDR/XDR/NDR/TIP/UEBA/VulnMgmt/CaseMgmt)
modules.notes: Composite SOC module. Includes automated response/SOAR playbooks, EDR/XDR endpoint telemetry, NDR/DPI/packet capture/TLS decryption, TIP/STIX-TAXII IoC lifecycle, UEBA behavioral baselining, vulnerability scanning/prioritization, incident triage & unified case mgmt. From MOE Appendix 6.

modules.name: StackX Security (SIEM / EDR / XDR / NDR / TIP / UEBA / VulnMgmt / CaseMgmt)
modules.notes: New module (post-Telemedicine enrichment). Unified security monitoring & response: SIEM log ingestion/correlation, EDR/XDR, NDR, TIP, UEBA, vulnerability mgmt, case mgmt. Includes Native/Integrated/Assured delivery-modes framing and extended-security-services catalog (8 service areas). Toolkit to extend: add {{module_stackx_security}} as a new optional module. Use module_stackx_soc for the fuller SOC operations scope if required.

modules.name: StackX DevOps Framework (CI/CD / IaC / DevSecOps)
modules.notes: CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform/Ansible), DevSecOps security integration, Dev→Staging→Prod pipeline with go/no-go gates, digital change/release record backbone, UAT governance, rollback planning.

cross_cutting.description: Included in every proposal unless explicitly excluded.

modules.name: Operations Level Agreement (OLA) Template
modules.notes: 4-priority model, 8x5 Sun–Thu 9–5, RACI, escalation hierarchy, reporting cadence. Placeholder response times — confirm per bid.

modules.name: Training Services
modules.notes: Included per Basem's instruction. DeviceX Admin + L1 Ops track; StackX Observer/Analyst/Architect 3-level track; SDX Edge Observer/Analyst/Architect 3-level track.

modules.name: Professional Services — Architecture, Design, Implementation & Roll-out
modules.notes: Standalone services engagement module. 18 mandatory scope-number slots (branches, network devices, apps monitored, workflows, endpoints, NVR cameras, IoT devices, tunnels, firewall policies, PBX extensions, virtualisation workloads, integrations, roles, training attendees, training sessions, acceptance-test sites, arch workshops, arch diagrams). In-scope and out-of-scope written to complete each other per phase. Separate from platform capability modules.

modules.name: Proposal Validity / Expiry Clause
modules.notes: 12-month default expiry from Effective Date; extension by mutual agreement 3+ months before expiry. Confirm legal review per bid.

customer_slots.customer_name: Full legal/customer-facing name of the prospect
customer_slots.proposal_date: Date the proposal is issued (DD Month YYYY)
customer_slots.site_count: Number of sites/branches/locations — used to flag hardware sizing as a separate exercise
customer_slots.compliance_frameworks: Customer-specific regulatory/compliance frameworks to call out (e.g. CBE, FRA, education-sector)
customer_slots.devicex_qty_note: Optional note about hardware quantity basis (e.g. 'to be confirmed via site survey')
customer_slots.esg_footprint: One-line description of the customer's distributed footprint (e.g. 'one of the largest educational networks in Egypt, serving millions of students across thousands of schools')
customer_slots.esg_value_1: First value statement for the executive summary (e.g. 'digital classrooms and e-learning')
customer_slots.esg_value_2: Second value statement for the executive summary (e.g. 'streamlined administrative operations')
customer_slots.esg_outcome: Outcome statement for the executive summary (e.g. 'data-driven insights for decision-making')
customer_slots.esg_example_a: First illustrative example for the executive summary (e.g. 'nationwide e-assessment platforms')
customer_slots.esg_example_b: Second illustrative example for the executive summary (e.g. 'connected schools and digital content repositories')
customer_slots.scope_services_description: One-line description of the services in scope (e.g. 'datacentres, backend systems, and school infrastructure')
customer_slots.deployment_context: What is being rapidly deployed (e.g. 'new business locations', 'new branch locations', 'new school sites')
customer_slots.objective_1: First acknowledged customer objective (e.g. 'Accelerate branch/school/site deployment')
customer_slots.objective_4: Fourth acknowledged customer objective (e.g. 'Implement on-demand virtual workloads')
customer_slots.objective_5: Fifth acknowledged customer objective (e.g. 'Host business-critical applications locally')
customer_slots.proposal_version: Proposal version identifier for the change-history table (e.g. '1.0')
customer_slots.proposal_status: Proposal status for the change-history table (e.g. 'Draft', 'For Review', 'Approved', 'Submitted')
customer_slots.proposal_date_iso: Proposal date in YYYY-MM-DD form for the change-history table (e.g. '2026-09-02')
customer_slots.author_name: Author name for the change-history table (e.g. 'VertoWave Proposal Team')
